panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Devices registered and known to the server.

panels.title: Healthy devices

targets.expr: count(count by (device_id) (mothasync_sync_last_run_result{job=~"$job"} == 1 and on (device_id) (time() - mothasync_sync_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job"} <= 86400 * 2))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Last run completed and reported within the last 2 days.

panels.title: Failing devices
panels.description: Devices whose last reported run did not complete (also includes devices that have not reported yet).

panels.title: Stale devices (>2d)

targets.expr: count(count by (device_id) (time() - max by (device_id, hostname) (mothasync_sync_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job"}) > 86400 * 2)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Devices without a report for more than two days.

panels.title: Fleet success rate (24h)
panels.description: Completed runs / (completed + failed) over the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Device status
panels.description: One row per device. Last result, time since last report, failed runs and data in the last 7 days.

panels.title: Time since last report per device
panels.description: Red after two days without a report.

panels.title: Sync runs by status
panels.description: Runs reported per interval, by status.
